name: Glide Bass
description: VCO-1's saw (through the ring modulator, its second input off) and VCO-3's a little apart, gliding: a fat, sliding bass.

name: Pluck Bass
description: VCO-3's saw through a resonant filter struck open and falling to nothing: a plucked, twanging bass.

name: Ring Bass
description: VCO-1's saw ringing against VCO-2's sine a fifth up, under its square: a hollow, metallic bass.

name: Rubber Bass
description: The square through a resonant filter that follows the keys, struck hard and closing onto the note itself: a rubbery, squelching bass.

name: Square Bass
description: VCO-1's square, the one ADSR on both the filter and the amplifier, each note falling a little as it is held: a round, plain bass, the panel's own way.

name: Sub Bass
description: VCO-1's square with VCO-2's pulse an octave under it, the filter low and barely moving: a deep, solid sub.

name: Sync Bass
description: VCO-2 synced to VCO-1 a fifth up, the ADSR sweeping its pitch down as it falls: a tearing sync bass.

name: Thump Bass
description: The square with a burst of noise as the filter opens and shuts: a bass with a thump at each note.

name: Ring Bell
description: VCO-1's saw fully ringed against VCO-2 an octave and a fifth up and a little sharp, struck and left to fade: a struck metal bell that rings on the key.

name: Brass
description: Two saws, the filter opening as the attack swells in: a single brass voice.

name: Space Drone
description: All three oscillators slowly apart, VCO-3 an octave down, a resonant filter, a slow swell and the spring: a long drone in space.

name: Duo Brass
description: Two voices of brass, the lowest and the highest of each chord, swelling in together.

name: Duo Lead
description: The keyboard's two voices: the lower key on VCO-1's square, the upper on VCO-2's pulse, so a held interval plays both.

name: Falling Tone
description: VCO-1 thrown three octaves up and falling slowly back while the key is held: a bomb's whistle.

name: Laser
description: The ADSR striking VCO-1's pitch three octaves up and dropping at once: a laser shot at each key.

name: Siren
description: VCO-3 in the low range as a slow LFO, its saw sweeping VCO-1 up over and over: an alarm siren.

name: Surf
description: White noise swelling in over a second and dying away slowly through the spring: a wave on a beach.

name: Thunder
description: Dark noise struck through a low filter and rumbling away into the spring: a thunderclap.

name: Trill
description: VCO-3's pulse at a few hertz flicking VCO-1 up a tone and back: a trill under a held key.

name: Wind
description: Pink noise through a resonant filter swept slowly by VCO-3's saw, swelling in: wind.

name: Init
description: The panel as it comes: VCO-1's square through the filter half open, the ADSR on the filter and the amplifier.

name: Classic Lead
description: All three oscillators a little apart through a filter that follows the keys, the vibrato coming in after a moment: the instrument's own singing lead.

name: Glide Lead
description: Two saws a few cents apart sliding from note to note, a slow vibrato: a smooth portamento lead.

name: Octave Lead
description: The square under VCO-2's narrow pulse an octave up: a hollow, reedy lead in octaves.

name: Ring Lead
description: VCO-1's saw ringing against VCO-2 an octave and a fifth up: a clangorous, bell-edged lead.

name: Screaming Lead
description: The square and VCO-3's saw through a filter near singing, a little of the spring: a screaming solo voice.

name: Sync Lead
description: VCO-2 synced to VCO-1 an octave up, the ADSR sweeping it down at each note: a bright, tearing sync lead.

name: Whistle
description: No oscillator at all: the filter singing at middle C and following the keys, a touch of vibrato: a pure, whistled line.

name: Closed Hat
description: Bright noise through the filter at its top, a short decay: a closed hi-hat.

name: Kick
description: The filter singing low with nothing through it, the ADSR striking it a few octaves up and letting it fall: a round, deep kick.

name: Metal Hit
description: Two oscillators an out-of-tune tritone apart through the ring modulator, struck and gone: a clanging metal hit.

name: Snare
description: White noise through the filter opened by a short strike: a dry, bright snare.

name: Tom
description: The sung filter higher, struck less far and following the keys an octave an octave: a tom tuned as it is played.

name: Zap Drum
description: The sung filter struck four octaves up and dropping fast: an electronic zap of a drum.

name: Spring Pluck
description: A short square pluck thrown into the spring at both sides: the tank's own splash after every note.

name: Bubbles
description: Random steps into the filter singing with nothing through it, the spring after it: bubbles rising in water.

name: Computer Chatter
description: The noise sampled twelve times a second, two octaves deep into VCO-1's pitch: a film computer thinking aloud.

name: Random Burble
description: The noise sampled ten times a second into the filter's third input, a resonant square under it: the classic burbling random filter.

name: Random Steps
description: The noise sampled five times a second into VCO-1's and VCO-2's pitch: random notes stepping under a held key.

name: Robot Talk
description: Random steps in VCO-1's pitch rung against VCO-2's sine, with a little resonance: a small robot chattering.

name: Staircase
description: VCO-3's slow saw sampled by a fast clock into the filter: its sweep climbs as a staircase, over and over.
